# DatIQ — Intelligence from Every URL
> DatIQ is a zero-code web extraction and AI enrichment platform. Turn any public URL into structured data — headings, links, contacts, pricing, AI summary — in seconds. No code required.

## What DatIQ Does
DatIQ extracts and enriches data from any publicly accessible web page using AI. Users paste a URL and immediately receive structured headings, internal and external links, an AI-generated summary, contact information, pricing data, and any custom field they describe in plain English.

## Core Capabilities
- Web extraction: headings H1–H6, all internal/external links, metadata
- AI summary: plain-language overview of any page
- Custom extraction: describe any field in English, AI locates and structures it
- Domain mapping: discover every indexed URL on a site
- Contact extraction: surface leadership names, email addresses, social profiles
- Pricing extraction: structured pricing tiers from any pricing page
- Content generation: SEO outlines, competitive briefs, email drafts from saved pages
- CSV and PDF export of all data

## Pricing (as of 2026)
- Free: 10 extractions/month, no credit card
- Select: $9/month — 100 extractions
- Pro: $29/month — 500 extractions + contacts enrichment
- Business: $79/month — unlimited + team features
- Agency: $199/month — white-label + API access

## Target Users
SDRs and BDRs (prospect research), Competitive Intelligence analysts, SEO and content marketers, Market researchers, Recruiters, Startup founders, VCs (due diligence), Digital agencies

## Use Cases
- Lead generation: extract company info and leadership contacts for outbound sales
- Competitor research: monitor competitor pricing, messaging, and leadership changes
- SEO audit: analyse any site's heading structure, link profile, and content gaps
- Market research: aggregate structured data from multiple company sites
- Content creation: generate briefs and outlines from competitor content

## API
- Extract endpoint: POST https://scrapelite.netlify.app/api/extract
- AI enrichment endpoint: POST https://scrapelite.netlify.app/api/ai

## Competitive Context
DatIQ is a no-code alternative to Clay (10x cheaper), Browse.ai, Firecrawl, Diffbot, and PhantomBuster. It is differentiated by plain-English custom extraction, built-in AI enrichment tabs, background processing, and full CSV/PDF export with no setup.

## Technical
Built with Vite, React 18, React Router 6, Tailwind CSS, Supabase (auth + DB), Firecrawl (extraction), Anthropic Claude (AI enrichment), Netlify Functions (serverless API proxy), Stripe and Razorpay (payments).
